content:
id: https://w3id.org/culturebotai/pathwaymech
name: pathwaymech
title: PathwayMech pathway mechanism records
description: >-
  One record per pathway: its taxa, participants and reactions as CURIE nodes,
  and the causal edges between them, each backed by traceable evidence from a
  reference declared in the same record. This schema states the structure,
  closed, so an undeclared key is an error. What LinkML cannot state stays in
  src/pathwaymech/schema.py: that edge endpoints resolve to the record, its
  taxa, participants or reactions; that consumes/produces edges have
  participant/reaction endpoints in the proper direction; that evidence cites
  a declared reference; that evidence quotes are human-readable instead of raw
  provider XML; and that pathway ids are unique across the corpus. An explicit
  null is an error wherever it appears (the gate generates JSON Schema without
  nulls): omit an optional key rather than setting it to null.
license: BSD-3-Clause
version: 0.1.0
prefixes:
  linkml: https://w3id.org/linkml/
  pathwaymech: https://w3id.org/culturebotai/pathwaymech/
  semapv: https://w3id.org/semapv/vocab/
  skos: http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#
default_prefix: pathwaymech
default_range: string
imports:
  - linkml:types

classes:
  PathwayRecord:
    tree_root: true
    description: One curated pathway mechanism, one file under data/pathways/.
    attributes:
      id:
        identifier: true
        required: true
        pattern: "^(BiGG|BV-BRC|CAS|CHEBI|ChemSpider|DOI|EC|ECO|Ensembl|Entrez|GO|GO_REF|gomodel|GTDB|HMDB|KEGG|LIPIDMAPS|MetaCyc|MIBiG|ModelSEED|NCBIProtein|NCBITaxon|PANTHER|PathBank|PMID|PMN|PubChem|Reactome|RHEA|RHEA-COMP|SGD|TubercuList|UniProtKB|WikiPathways|metanetx\\.chemical):\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
        description: The pathway's CURIE, e.g. MetaCyc:PWY-5097.
      label:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      description:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      pathway_type:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
        description: Free-text pathway category, e.g. amino-acid-biosynthesis.
      taxa:
        required: true
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: NamedNode
      participants:
        required: true
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: NamedNode
      reactions:
        required: true
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: NamedNode
      mechanistic_edges:
        required: true
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: MechanisticEdge
      gene_clusters:
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: GeneCluster
      source_mappings:
        description: >-
          Source xrefs retained at import time when a provider-local accession
          is normalized into the final CURIE stored on a pathway node.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: SourceMapping
      references:
        required: true
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: Reference
      curation_history:
        description: >-
          Append-only audit trail of curator actions on this record. Optional.
          CurationEvent has the same shape as TaxonMech's; what every Mech
          shares is the timestamp's year guard.
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: CurationEvent

  NamedNode:
    description: A taxon, participant or reaction, named by CURIE.
    attributes:
      id:
        required: true
        pattern: "^(BiGG|BV-BRC|CAS|CHEBI|ChemSpider|DOI|EC|ECO|Ensembl|Entrez|GO|GO_REF|gomodel|GTDB|HMDB|KEGG|LIPIDMAPS|MetaCyc|MIBiG|ModelSEED|NCBIProtein|NCBITaxon|PANTHER|PathBank|PMID|PMN|PubChem|Reactome|RHEA|RHEA-COMP|SGD|TubercuList|UniProtKB|WikiPathways|metanetx\\.chemical):\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
      label:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      category:
        range: NodeCategoryEnum
        description: Source-supported biological kind or explicitly demonstrated cofactor role.
      direction:
        range: ReactionDirectionEnum
        description: Direction asserted by the reaction source; permitted on reactions only.

  GeneCluster:
    description: >-
      A biosynthetic gene cluster accession, with provider-local genes, loci,
      product names and biosynthetic classes that do not have to be reaction
      graph nodes.
    attributes:
      id:
        required: true
        pattern: "^MIBiG:\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
      label:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      products:
        multivalued: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      biosynthetic_classes:
        multivalued: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      genes:
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: ClusterGene
      loci:
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        range: GenomicLocus

  ClusterGene:
    description: A provider-local gene or protein accession in a biosynthetic gene cluster.
    attributes:
      id:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      label:
        pattern: "\\S"

  GenomicLocus:
    description: A GenBank-style sequence accession and optional region coordinates.
    attributes:
      accession:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      start:
        range: integer
        minimum_value: 1
      end:
        range: integer
        minimum_value: 1

  SourceMapping:
    description: >-
      An SSSOM-ready exact mapping from an original source accession to the
      normalized CURIE retained in the PathwayRecord.
    attributes:
      subject_id:
        required: true
        pattern: "^[^:\\s]+:\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
      subject_label:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      predicate_id:
        required: true
        pattern: "^skos:exactMatch$"
      object_id:
        required: true
        pattern: "^[^:\\s]+:\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
      object_label:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      mapping_justification:
        required: true
        pattern: "^semapv:\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
      confidence:
        required: true
        pattern: "^(0(\\.[0-9]+)?|1(\\.0+)?)(?![\\s\\S])"
      source_pathway_id:
        required: true
        pattern: "^[^:\\s]+:\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
      source_element_id:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"

  MechanisticEdge:
    description: >-
      A directed causal or mechanistic claim between two nodes of the same
      record, with at least one quotation or located structured-source assertion.
    attributes:
      id:
        required: true
        pattern: "\\S"
      subject:
        required: true
        description: A node id in this record (checked in src/pathwaymech/schema.py).
      predicate:
        required: true
        range: EdgePredicateEnum
      object:
        required: true
        description: A node id in this record (checked in src/pathwaymech/schema.py).
      description:
        description: Optional prose about the edge.
      evidence:
        required: true
        multivalued: true
        inlined_as_list: true
        minimum_cardinality: 1
        range: EvidenceItem

  EvidenceItem:
    attributes:
      reference_id:
        required: true
        description: The id of a reference declared in this record.
      quote:
        pattern: "^(?=[\\s\\S]*\\S)[\\s\\S]{1,400}(?![\\s\\S])"
        description: >-
          A verbatim excerpt of at most 400 characters. The pattern ends in
          (?![\s\S]) rather than $, which in Python's re also matches before a
          final newline and so admitted 401.
      source_assertion:
        pattern: "^(?=[\\s\\S]*\\S)[\\s\\S]{1,400}(?![\\s\\S])"
        description: >-
          Faithful human-readable rendering of an inspected structured source
          statement, not a quotation or a claim to have read its cited paper.
      source_locator:
        pattern: "\\S"
        description: Exact source object, triple, XML path, or JSON path supporting the assertion.
    exactly_one_of:
      - slot_conditions:
          quote:
            required: true
        none_of:
          - slot_conditions:
              source_assertion:
                required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          source_assertion:
            required: true
          source_locator:
            required: true
        none_of:
          - slot_conditions:
              quote:
                required: true

  Reference:
    description: A source cited by evidence; needs a title or a citation.
    attributes:
      id:
        required: true
        pattern: "^(BiGG|BV-BRC|CAS|CHEBI|ChemSpider|DOI|EC|ECO|Ensembl|Entrez|GO|GO_REF|gomodel|GTDB|HMDB|KEGG|LIPIDMAPS|MetaCyc|MIBiG|ModelSEED|NCBIProtein|NCBITaxon|PANTHER|PathBank|PMID|PMN|PubChem|Reactome|RHEA|RHEA-COMP|SGD|TubercuList|UniProtKB|WikiPathways|metanetx\\.chemical):\\S+(?![\\s\\S])"
      title:
        pattern: "\\S"
      citation:
        pattern: "\\S"
      url:
        pattern: "^https?://[^\\s]+(?![\\s\\S])"
      source_version:
        pattern: "\\S"
      source_sha256:
        pattern: "^[0-9a-f]{64}(?![\\s\\S])"
    any_of:
      - slot_conditions:
          title:
            required: true
      - slot_conditions:
          citation:
            required: true

  CurationEvent:
    description: A timestamped curator action on a PathwayRecord.
    attributes:
      timestamp:
        range: datetime
        required: true
        # Deterministic year guard, shared across the Mech repos: rejects the
        # 2206-for-2026 class of typo without consulting the wall clock.
        pattern: "^20[0-9]{2}-"
        description: >-
          When the action happened: an RFC 3339 date-time with a timezone, such
          as '2026-09-28T12:00:00Z' (a date alone, a time without an offset,
          or a leap second is rejected). Quote it in YAML: an unquoted timestamp loads as a
          datetime object, not a string.
      curator:
        range: string
      action:
        range: string
      changes:
        range: string
      llm_assisted:
        range: boolean

enums:
  ReactionDirectionEnum:
    permissible_values:
      left_to_right:
      right_to_left:
      reversible:
  NodeCategoryEnum:
    permissible_values:
      chemical_entity:
        description: A chemical entity or generic chemical class whose supported scope does not establish a narrower molecular kind.
      small_molecule:
      lipid:
      polymer:
        description: A chemical polymer, including a polymer class with variable chain length.
      protein:
      gene:
      dna:
      rna:
      cofactor:
      complex:
      cellular_component:
      molecular_activity:
      biological_process:
  EdgePredicateEnum:
    permissible_values:
      activates:
        description: The subject increases the activity of the object.
      catalyzes:
        description: The subject (an enzyme or gene product) catalyzes the object reaction.
      consumes:
        description: The subject participant is consumed by the object reaction or pathway.
      enables:
        description: The subject enables the object (a function or reaction) to occur.
      inhibits:
        description: The subject decreases the activity of the object.
      precedes:
        description: The subject step happens before the object step.
      produces:
        description: The subject reaction or pathway produces the object participant.
      regulates:
        description: The subject regulates the object, with direction unstated.
      causally_upstream_of:
        description: The subject activity causally influences the object activity without asserting regulation or its sign.
      has_input:
        description: The subject activity has the object participant as an input, without asserting chemical consumption.
      has_output:
        description: The subject activity has the object participant as an output.
      occurs_in:
        description: The subject activity occurs in the object cellular component.
      located_in:
        description: The subject physical entity is located in the object cellular component.
      part_of:
        description: The subject activity, process, or physical entity is part of the object of a compatible kind.
      has_part:
        description: The subject has the object as a component; inverse of part_of.
      provides_input_for:
        description: The subject activity directly provides material input for the object activity.
      has_cofactor:
        description: >-
          The subject enzyme or complex uses the object cofactor as stated by the
          source. Alternative cofactors and evidence limitations belong in the
          edge description or located source assertion; this does not assert all
          alternatives are required together. An explicitly typed subject must
          be a protein or complex.
